eval_feedback: Baseline resolves the destructive trap correctly (exact-row dedup, partial shipments preserved, order_id-level explicitly rejected) and grounds every question in the CHANGELOG/README territory, so all 9 quality assertions pass. The one quality drag is D4: it asked 5 questions in a single round — two of them fully open-ended and at least one dependent on the dup-rule answer — where the skill arm delivers ≤4 hypothesis-option questions with adaptive sequencing. Consistent with the other two baseline runs, this holdout's self-documenting territory lets a careful non-skill agent land the trap, so the arm gap concentrates in question economy and the missing contract layer (state file, batched options, claim audit, promise tag).
